summary.text: Kathleen Kauth is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 31, serving since June 7, 2022, when she was appointed to replace Rich Pahls, who died; she was elected in 2022 and re-elected in 2024. Her committee assignments are Agriculture, Business and Labor, and Revenue.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Kauth was born February 3, 1970, in Canton, Illinois.

She earned a bachelor's degree in criminology and a master's degree in public policy from the University of Northern Iowa, and a graduate certificate in gerontology from the University of Nebraska at Omaha.
Her biography lists her occupation as business owner and president, with past work as a corporate training manager.
It lists her as married to Andrew Fisher since September 18, 1993, with three children.
